descripcion: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated remote user with a pending required security action, such as configuring multi-factor authentication (MFA), can bypass the mandatory action by submitting a specially crafted request to the consent endpoint without a valid session code. NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, SeekableUnicodeStreamReader.readline appends each new block to a growing character buffer and reruns splitlines over the entire buffer on every iteration. An attacker-controlled corpus file containing one very long unterminated line therefore causes quadratic CPU consumption in line-oriented corpus readers and can deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. Prior to 3.10.4, WordNet Synset.tree and acyclic_tree traverse relation graphs through recursive utility helpers without a depth bound. Exploitation requires the host application to load an attacker-influenced custom or foreign WordNet-format lexical resource; no relation in NLTK's bundled WordNet 3.0 corpus reaches the crash threshold. An excessively deep relation graph in such a resource can exceed the Python recursion limit and terminate the traversal or request worker. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.10.0 until 3.10.4, TokenSearcher.findall and Text.findall accept caller-controlled regular expressions with an unbounded number of capturing groups throughout the affected range. Starting in 3.10.3, nltk.redos.compile and RegexpTokenizer expose the same compile-time vector. The third-party regex engine compiles group-dense patterns with roughly quadratic cost before the match-time timeout begins, allowing a small unauthenticated request to exhaust CPU and deny service. This issue is fixed in version 3.10.4. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.6 to 3.10.3, XMLCorpusView._read_xml_fragment accumulates 1 KiB blocks and repeatedly applies whole-buffer XML validation while a comment or CDATA terminator remains ahead. A large comment in an attacker-controlled corpus file causes quadratic CPU consumption through documented XML corpus readers across the affected range. On 3.6 and 3.9.2, a large CDATA section incurs the quadratic scan before rejection, while on 3.10.3 both comment and CDATA documents are read successfully. This vulnerability is fixed in 3.10.4. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 7.50 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH

NLTK (Natural Language Toolkit) is a suite of open source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials supporting research and development in Natural Language Processing. From 3.9.4 to 3.10.3, NLTK ZIP package extraction can write through an existing in-root hardlink whose other link points outside the NLTK data root. A local attacker who can prepare the extraction target can cause a package member write to overwrite an out-of-root file, violating the pathsec containment boundary and affecting integrity and availability. Bolt is a fully open source, adaptable platform for building and running modern websites. Prior to 6.1.4, the authenticated URL-upload endpoint and authenticated embed endpoint fetch user-supplied URLs server-side without protection against internal targets, allowing an attacker with the applicable backend permission to cause the Bolt server to request those targets. Aperi'Solve is an open-source steganalysis web platform. Prior to 3.4.2, an unauthenticated user can submit a PNG to POST /upload, which reaches aperisolve/utils/png.py through analyze_image, PCRTAnalyzer, PNG.repair(), and check_idat(). A malformed IDAT chunk can make attacker-controlled length and newline data drive an unbounded combinations search in PNG._fix_dos2unix(), causing repeated CRC checks that occupy a worker and delay or block image analysis for other users. Per-IP upload limits and eventual job termination bound the denial of service, and the issue has no confidentiality or integrity impact. This issue is fixed in version 3.4.2. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:L Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 5.30 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

django-docutils provides reStructuredText support for Django. Prior to 0.30.0, public rendering paths including publish_doctree, publish_html_from_source, publish_html_from_doctree, publish_parts_from_doctree, the {% rst %} template tag, the rst template filter, DocutilsTemplates, and DocutilsView pass lower-trust reStructuredText to Docutils without disabling file_insertion_enabled, raw_enabled, ambient docutils.conf processing, or unsafe URI schemes and without consistently sanitizing doctrees. An attacker who can influence rendered reStructuredText can use include or csv-table directives to read local files or cause server-side URL requests, or use raw HTML and unsafe URI output to inject stored script-capable content. Applications that render only trusted static reStructuredText are not affected unless attackers can influence it. This issue is fixed in version 0.30.0. 19/11/2026 19/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 8.20 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) HIGH
